label: accept
reason: The quote states 'causes of hypophosphatemia are primary hyperparathyroidism', which directly supports the claim that primary hyperparathyroidism is a cause of hypophosphatemia. The reviewer who rejected the claim focused on the comparative phrase 'Much more common', but this phrase does not negate the underlying causal relationship asserted by the claim; it only adds information about frequency which the claim does not attempt to capture.
